883: /// Conditional `DELETE` that removes one existing supported event through the
884: /// domain service and retains the DAV mapping as a durable tombstone.
885: ///
886: /// Requires `If-Match` carrying the current ETag. Fails with 412 when the
887: /// precondition is missing or stale, without mutating the event. On success the
888: /// event is deleted and the resource row is tombstoned (event reference
889: /// cleared, deletion stamped) so the mapping survives for other clients. If the
890: /// domain delete fails after the tombstone is written, the tombstone is
891: /// compensated back to the live mapping.
892: async fn handle_delete_event_resource(
893:     accounts: &CaldavAccountService,
894:     session: &DavSession,
895:     calendar: &CaldavCalendar,
896:     resource_name: &str,
897:     request: Request,
898: ) -> Response {
899:     let Ok(role) = CalendarRole::from_str(&calendar.role) else {
900:         return dav_server_error();
901:     };
902:     if authorize_calendar_action(
903:         UserStatus::Active,
904:         Some(PlatformRole::User),
905:         Some(role),
906:         CalendarAction::EditAnyEvent,
907:     ) != AuthorizationDecision::Allow
908:     {
909:         return dav_resource_not_found();
910:     }
911: 
912:     let if_match = request
913:         .headers()
914:         .get(header::IF_MATCH)
915:         .and_then(|value| value.to_str().ok());
916:     let Some(if_match) = if_match else {
917:         return (
918:             StatusCode::PRECONDITION_FAILED,
919:             "If-Match is required to delete a resource",
920:         )
921:             .into_response();
922:     };
923: 
924:     let repository = CaldavRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone());
925:     let resource = match repository
926:         .resolve_by_name(calendar.calendar_id, resource_name)
927:         .await
928:     {
929:         Ok(Some(resource)) => resource,
930:         Ok(None) => return dav_resource_not_found(),
931:         Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
932:     };
933:     if event_is_imported(accounts.pool(), resource.event_id).await {
934:         return dav_resource_not_found();
935:     }
936: 
937:     let event = match EventRepository::new(accounts.pool().clone())
938:         .event(calendar.calendar_id, resource.event_id)
939:         .await
940:     {
941:         Ok(Some(event)) => event,
942:         Ok(None) => return dav_resource_not_found(),
943:         Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
944:     };
945:     let Some((_, current_etag)) = ical_and_etag(&resource, &event, DavReadAccess::Details) else {
946:         return dav_resource_not_found();
947:     };
948:     if !etag_matches(if_match, &current_etag) {
949:         return (StatusCode::PRECONDITION_FAILED, "precondition failed").into_response();
950:     }
951: 
952:     let now = accounts.now();
953:     let tombstoned = match repository
954:         .tombstone_resource(calendar.calendar_id, resource.event_id, now)
955:         .await
956:     {
957:         Ok(tombstoned) => tombstoned,
958:         Err(_) => return dav_server_error(),
959:     };
960:     if !tombstoned {
961:         // The live mapping disappeared between the precondition check and the
962:         // tombstone write; treat as an already-deleted resource.
963:         return dav_resource_not_found();
964:     }
965: 
966:     let event_service = EventService::new_at(accounts.pool().clone(), accounts.now());
967:     let delete_result = event_service
968:         .delete(
969:             session.user_id,
970:             false,
971:             calendar.calendar_id,
972:             resource.event_id,
973:         )
974:         .await;
975:     if let Err(error) = delete_result {
976:         // Compensate the tombstone so the mapping is not left dangling.
977:         let _ = repository
978:             .restore_resource(
979:                 calendar.calendar_id,
980:                 resource.event_id,
981:                 resource_name,
982:                 accounts.now(),
983:             )
984:             .await;
985:         return match error {
986:             EventServiceError::NotFound => dav_resource_not_found(),
987:             EventServiceError::ReadOnly => dav_resource_not_found(),
988:             _ => dav_server_error(),
989:         };
990:     }
991: 
992:     // The tombstone was applied before the domain delete, so the change-log
993:     // entry recorded by the domain service could not resolve the resource name
994:     // from the live mapping. Stamp it now so sync-collection can emit the
995:     // correct href for this deletion.
996:     let _ = repository
997:         .stamp_change_resource_name(calendar.calendar_id, resource.event_id, resource_name)
998:         .await;
999: 
1000:     StatusCode::NO_CONTENT.into_response()
1001: }

1003: /// True when an `If-Match` precondition is satisfied by the current ETag.
1004: ///
1005: /// Accepts the wildcard and a comma-separated list of strong ETags, comparing
1006: /// each against the current tag.
1007: fn etag_matches(if_match: &str, current_etag: &str) -> bool {
1008:     let if_match = if_match.trim();
1009:     if if_match == "*" {
1010:         return true;
1011:     }
1012:     if_match
1013:         .split(',')
1014:         .map(|tag| tag.trim())
1015:         .any(|tag| tag == current_etag)
1016: }

1040:         .get("depth")

1051: fn parse_depth(headers: &axum::http::HeaderMap) -> Option<DavDepth> {

504:     /// Encode a change-log revision into an opaque, tamper-evident sync token.
505:     ///
506:     /// The token is `base64url(revision) . base64url(hmac)`. Clients treat it
507:     /// as an opaque string; the server verifies the HMAC before trusting the
508:     /// revision, so a forged or truncated token fails safely.
509:     pub fn encode_sync_token(&self, revision: i64) -> String {
510:         let (revision_bytes, tag) = self.key.sign_sync_revision(revision);
511:         format!(
512:             "{}.{}",
513:             URL_SAFE_NO_PAD.encode(revision_bytes),
514:             URL_SAFE_NO_PAD.encode(tag)
515:         )
516:     }
517: 
518:     /// Decode and verify a sync token, returning the revision it carries.
519:     ///
520:     /// Returns `None` for any malformed, truncated, or tampered token so the
521:     /// caller can fail safely without leaking which check failed.
522:     pub fn decode_sync_token(&self, token: &str) -> Option<i64> {
523:         let (encoded_revision, encoded_tag) = token.split_once('.')?;
524:         let revision_bytes = URL_SAFE_NO_PAD.decode(encoded_revision).ok()?;
525:         let tag = URL_SAFE_NO_PAD.decode(encoded_tag).ok()?;
526:         if revision_bytes.len() != 8 {
527:             return None;
528:         }
529:         if !self.key.verify_sync_revision(&revision_bytes, &tag) {
530:             return None;
531:         }
532:         let mut bytes = [0_u8; 8];
533:         bytes.copy_from_slice(&revision_bytes);
534:         Some(i64::from_be_bytes(bytes))
535:     }
536: }

101: async fn request(
102:     app: Router,
103:     method: Method,
104:     uri: &str,
105:     auth: Option<(&str, &str)>,
106: ) -> (StatusCode, HeaderMap, String) {
107:     let mut builder = Request::builder().method(method).uri(uri);
108:     if let Some((username, password)) = auth {
109:         builder = builder.header(header::AUTHORIZATION, basic_header(username, password));
110:     }
111:     let response = app
112:         .oneshot(builder.body(Body::empty()).unwrap())
113:         .await
114:         .unwrap();
115:     let status = response.status();
116:     let headers = response.headers().clone();
117:     let body = response.into_body().collect().await.unwrap().to_bytes();
118:     (status, headers, String::from_utf8_lossy(&body).into_owned())
119: }

574: /// Return the `.ics` resource name listed in a calendar PROPFIND response.
575: fn extract_resource_name(body: &str) -> Option<String> {
576:     for line in body.lines() {
577:         if line.contains("<D:href>") && line.contains(".ics") {
578:             let start = line.find("<D:href>")? + "<D:href>".len();
579:             let href = line[start..].trim_end().strip_suffix("</D:href>")?;
580:             let name = href.rsplit('/').next()?.strip_suffix(".ics")?;
581:             return Some(name.to_owned());
582:         }
583:     }
584:     None
585: }

574: /// Return the `.ics` resource name listed in a calendar PROPFIND response.
575: fn extract_resource_name(body: &str) -> Option<String> {
576:     for line in body.lines() {
577:         if line.contains("<D:href>") && line.contains(".ics") {
578:             let start = line.find("<D:href>")? + "<D:href>".len();
579:             let href = line[start..].trim_end().strip_suffix("</D:href>")?;
580:             let name = href.rsplit('/').next()?.strip_suffix(".ics")?;
581:             return Some(name.to_owned());
582:         }
583:     }
584:     None
585: }

1138: /// Issue a `PUT` to an existing resource with an `If-Match` precondition.
1139: async fn put_update_request(
1140:     app: Router,
1141:     uri: &str,
1142:     auth: Option<(&str, &str)>,
1143:     body: &str,
1144:     if_match: Option<&str>,
1145: ) -> (StatusCode, HeaderMap, String) {
1146:     let mut builder = Request::builder()
1147:         .method(Method::PUT)
1148:         .uri(uri)
1149:         .header(header::CONTENT_TYPE, "text/calendar; charset=utf-8");
1150:     if let Some((username, password)) = auth {
1151:         builder = builder.header(header::AUTHORIZATION, basic_header(username, password));
1152:     }
1153:     if let Some(value) = if_match {
1154:         builder = builder.header(header::IF_MATCH, value);
1155:     }
1156:     let response = app
1157:         .oneshot(builder.body(Body::from(body.to_owned())).unwrap())
1158:         .await
1159:         .unwrap();
1160:     let status = response.status();
1161:     let headers = response.headers().clone();
1162:     let body = response.into_body().collect().await.unwrap().to_bytes();
1163:     (status, headers, String::from_utf8_lossy(&body).into_owned())
1164: }

1471: /// Issue a conditional `DELETE` with an `If-Match` precondition.
1472: async fn delete_request(
1473:     app: Router,
1474:     uri: &str,
1475:     auth: Option<(&str, &str)>,
1476:     if_match: Option<&str>,
1477: ) -> (StatusCode, HeaderMap, String) {
1478:     let mut builder = Request::builder().method(Method::DELETE).uri(uri);
1479:     if let Some((username, password)) = auth {
1480:         builder = builder.header(header::AUTHORIZATION, basic_header(username, password));
1481:     }
1482:     if let Some(value) = if_match {
1483:         builder = builder.header(header::IF_MATCH, value);
1484:     }
1485:     let response = app
1486:         .oneshot(builder.body(Body::empty()).unwrap())
1487:         .await
1488:         .unwrap();
1489:     let status = response.status();
1490:     let headers = response.headers().clone();
1491:     let body = response.into_body().collect().await.unwrap().to_bytes();
1492:     (status, headers, String::from_utf8_lossy(&body).into_owned())
1493: }
